summary: No covering test exercises an evidence glob matching multiple files (every fixture glob matches exactly one), so a mutant hashing only the first file matched per group's evidence globs passes all 15 tests in tests/evidence-groups.test.ts — REQ-013.2.1's 'content of every repository file matched by the evidence globs' (e.g. a helpers/*.ts glob) is unverified, and dropping matches would silently preserve stale approvals.
